environment.description: Same Spring Boot application deployed on the same EC2 instance type, but origin access is mediated through a CloudFront distribution with a custom origin access configuration. The CloudFront distribution has a Behavior configured with 'Restrict Viewer Access' set to 'Yes' using a Trusted Key Group (key group ID: kg-0a1b2c3d4e5f) for signed URL validation. The origin (ALB) security group ingress rule is scoped exclusively to the CloudFront managed prefix list (com.amazonaws.global.cloudfront.origin-facing, pl-3b927c52) on port 443, meaning no direct internet client can reach the ALB without passing through CloudFront's signed URL validation layer. The CloudFront cache behavior requires signed URLs with a 60-second expiry policy. Additionally, the EC2 instance runs with a read-only root filesystem mounted via tmpfs at /tmp with noexec,nosuid,size=50M flags, and the application process runs under a dedicated systemd unit with ProtectSystem=strict, PrivateTmp=yes, and NoNewPrivileges=true directives.
